Plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Assessment: docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md
Work key: Q03.3
Accountable role (person unassigned): Institutional operator and service owner
Pilot scope: required

Scope: Make pilot readiness a deliberate evidence-backed decision.
Work kind: institutional
Acceptance gate: Q03 (bd-01M4W40M7DJRQJWNCBEPR0AFEN)

Acceptance criteria:
1. Verify every required epic/gate and any EP7/EP8 activated by SITE01 is complete; reconcile the dependency graph against the accepted scope.
2. Bind the release artifact, configuration, support matrix, capacity, identity/access, user/accessibility and recovery evidence; no stale-source receipt or not-run human result counts as passed.
3. Named service owner, curator and operator record go/no-go, accepted limits, support ownership and rollback/recovery plan; a go authorizes only the bounded pilot, not primary-repository source cutover.

Verification: Versioned pilot acceptance manifest and named decision; program remains open on missing decisions or required evidence.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/Q03.3/receipt.json
Evidence must include: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input.

External inputs (never assume supplied):
- Named pilot acceptance owners
